It sounds like you've received a very threatening call about a parcel and now a "police officer" is asking for your Aadhaar and bank details. This is a common tactic in what's known as a "digital arrest" scam.

The police or any government agency will never ask for your personal details like Aadhaar or bank information over the phone to prove your innocence or threaten to freeze your account. These are all signs of a scam.
